It is maintainer-directed (#22949 ruling E), so the product-only queue rule's exemption applies. - **Why p2 here, not p3:** two files in this lane (`build-schemas-check-mode.test.ts` at 902 s, `check-liveness.test.ts` at 493 s) dominate the full battery's wall time. They are the largest input to the shard-timing drift that has turned the hourly run red before (#23107).
